scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dump -U newsfeed -d newsfeed --clean > backups/newsfeed-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql && ls -t backups | head -1
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U newsfeed -d newsfeed
scripts.db:recreate: for db in newsfeed newsfeed_test; do docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U newsfeed -d $db -qc 'DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS drizzle CASCADE; DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;'; done && echo 'Đã xoá schema của newsfeed và newsfeed_test – server sẽ tự migrate + seed khi khởi động.'
